name: Reasoning engine
description: Understands every request in any language, prepares a verified plan and runs it: first in shadow, then in place of the current path.
capabilities: Capabilities update themselves from tools, connectors and MCP servers.
In shadow the engine decides next to the current path without acting and measures how much it agrees.
Active mode opens only once the cutover gate is passed, unless the super admin forces it.
The execution journal is encrypted and prevents duplicate sends after a restart.
